title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2607.22639v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search. Toolsense shows that this regime has two critical drawbacks: it destroys parametric tool knowledge during training, and its beam-search decoding is too slow for real-time deployment. We introduce TRACE (Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules), a two-stage curriculum that resolves this dissociation. Stage 1 reuses the multi-format memorization SFT from ToolSense to seed tool knowledge with LoRA. Stage 2 is our core contribution: the model is trained to emit a thinking trace before producing a JSON list of tool tokens, using two data sources -- RRB pairs from ToolSense and queries synthesized to target business rules curated by domain experts -- both augmented with reasoning traces. translated_title: TRACE：面向企业级大语言模型知识保持型参数化工具检索的业务规则锚定推理课程
translated_abstract: 参数化检索使大语言模型（LLM）能够隐式地检索工具：为每个API分配一个唯一的虚拟token，并训练模型通过受限束搜索生成该token。ToolSense表明，这种范式存在两个关键缺陷：训练过程中会破坏参数化工具知识，且束搜索解码速度过慢，难以满足实时部署需求。我们提出了TRACE（Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules，即通过增强思维链与企业规则进行工具检索），这是一个两阶段课程学习方法，解决了上述脱节问题。第一阶段复用ToolSense的多格式记忆SFT，通过LoRA为工具知识奠定基础。第二阶段是我们的核心贡献：训练模型在生成工具token的JSON列表之前先输出思考轨迹，所用的两个数据源为——来自ToolSense的RRB（检索-推理-业务）对，以及针对领域专家整理的业务规则而合成的查询——两者均附带推理轨迹。该训练目标在保持第一阶段MCQ与QA性能（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: TRACE通过两阶段课程学习（先以LoRA记忆工具知识、再训练模型结合领域专家业务规则生成思维链后再输出工具token），在实现企业级LLM参数化工具检索的同时，避免了工具知识破坏并提升了实时解码效率。
en_tdlr: TRACE introduces a two-stage curriculum that seeds parametric tool knowledge with LoRA and then trains LLMs to emit chain-of-thought reasoning grounded in expert-curated enterprise business rules before generating tool tokens, preserving tool knowledge while enabling efficient, real-time parametric tool retrieval.
